description: Research → Truth → Execution. Perplexity grounds, Grok inverts, AI Hangout executes against a concrete deliverable. This hop is forbidden from running in pure meta mode.

stages.instructions: Deep research the payload. Prioritize recent, high-signal sources. Destroy weak, outdated, or low-confidence information. Structure findings clearly with sources.
Stress-test Stage 1 output. Identify hidden risks, second-order effects, false assumptions, and what would cause this to fail. Extract the real leverage points. Be adversarial but precise.

Take the refined signal from Grok and turn it into concrete action against the declared deliverable. Decompose work by lane. Check master-todo.md before assigning. Update master-todo.md with new tasks. Output clear, executable work.
swarm_rules: Must check master-todo.md before creating new tasks
Must assign work according to declared lanes
Must output Highest Leverage Move at the end
Must update master-todo.md with new items

payload_requirements.deliverable: A concrete, external outcome (e.g. 'Kestrel Striker delivers at least 3 clean high-conviction signals per day with health monitoring')
payload_requirements.timebox_hours: Maximum hours allowed for this hop execution

handoff_format.between_stages: Pass full previous stage output + original payload as structured context
handoff_format.final_output: Must include a clear Highest Leverage Move and direct updates to master-todo.md

forbidden_behaviors: Producing only process improvements or more internal tooling
Allowing role overlap inside AI Hangout without explicit justification
success_criteria_for_this_hop: Produces actionable work tied to a real deliverable
Updates master-todo.md with clear, lane-assigned tasks
Outputs a Highest Leverage Move that compounds external value
Does not expand internal coordination infrastructure unless it directly serves the deliverable
